evidence_policy: lossless original bytes/clocks before pass assertions; evidence failure halts success, secondary diagnostics preserve initiating error; read-only child cannot restore/control services
hard_limits: This is conditional bounded static-attestation reuse, not a fresh complete installed-file/Catalog scan at the endpoint. If the latter is mandatory, this design is ineligible under the no-second-scan constraint.

Static file/namespace/same-incarnation guards cannot honestly prove every later database transaction or arbitrary root dependency mutation; keep earlier attestation scope explicit and require the final full new-data audit.
The selected original1200 deadline includes all added completion/T0 gating; prestart exhaustion must fail, never create a new grace window.
No30s fast-check latency or process-tree cleanup claim has been measured here; exact candidate, full-prefix fixtures and actual affected Linux/reader qualification are mandatory.
preferred_source_reuse: exact VpsReadinessEvaluator with only guarded identity_verifier installed-subproof and catalog_ready integrity-attestation adapters
